svg.text: Terrain from OpenStreetMap — the wizard: 3 Preview, 4 Import (DESIGN_Terrain_From_OSM.md §6)
Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
9 shapes dropped (< 12 m² or too thin)
Data: © OpenStreetMap contributors · Copernicus DEM GLO-30
③ Preview — the fetched data drawn over the DIMMED tiles in HROT's own 2-D map colours (buildings by height = TerrainPlan2D.HeightColor; woods,

water, walls as on the scenario map). Each layer toggles; hover a building = its id and type, storeys and roof (and whether tagged), doors (the rule) and windows, shared walls; click a note = zoom to it.
The budget bars: green to 2×, amber 2–3× ("heavier than HROT is tuned for"), red above 3× = Import greyed and "pick a smaller box". No heights yet (see §14.3).
Until the terrain importer is built:
— the terrain importer is not built yet.
④ Import — one row per stage with its own bar and what it produced; Cancel stops at the next safe point and writes nothing (temp folder discarded).
"Run in background" closes the window and keeps a progress toast; a failure names the service or the stage and offers Retry (cached downloads are kept).
